title: Senior Engineer Cloud Infrastructure
teaser: We are recruiting a Senior Engineer Cloud Infrastructure to manage and orchestrate SD-WAN cloud controllers and services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality operations. Ideal candidates bring extensive experience in cloud infrastructure and a strong commitment to technical excellence.
description:
Meet the Team 

Cisco SD-WAN Cloud Team (Previously, Viptela Cloud Team) builds, deploys, and manages the entire SD-WAN cloud infrastructure for enterprises and SPs. With the growth and expansion of SD-WAN, we are looking to expand our team in all aspects. We work with multiple clouds and collaborate with multiple teams including an outsourced ops team. You will work with the SD-WAN solution team, Cloud development and test teams to orchestrate controllers and services for SD-WAN. This management will be through the entire ordering, provisioning, on-boarding and complete lifecycle of the controllers.

What You'll Do
You’re deeply motivated Cloud Engineer and passionate about learning and contributing to the business operations with a "can do" attitude. Knowledge of operating large-scale SaaS systems is preferred. Dedication to Quality: Ability to ensure and commit to a higher standard of quality than usual in face of tough customer production situations.

Minimum Qualifications 

Masters / bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar field.

6+ years of proven experience with web applications/services and public cloud platforms: AWS/Azure/Google

6+ years of relevant experience with operations, technical/customer support roles Cloud.

Experience with orchestration, monitoring and troubleshooting of web-based applications/services.

Knowledge of IP networking, security and access mechanisms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with private cloud platforms such as VMWare and Open stack.

Strong competence, and proficiency with Python/Perl/TCL and Linux/Unix Administration.

Strong team building skills, with the ability to work across departments and other teams.

Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work independently with minimal managerial guidance.

Strong sense of ownership and teamwork.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
